intent: Show that the monthly price of the hepatitis C drug Sovaldi is higher in the United States than in five other developed countries.

requirements.question: How does the monthly Sovaldi price in the United States compare with the five other countries?
Are all data marks declared by G0 present in the required state or states?

scope.selection: all data rows (table has no role column)

units.claim: The United States has the highest monthly Sovaldi price at about $29,883, compared with about $13,805 to $17,073 in the five other countries.
accept: the United States has the tallest bar and the highest price
the U.S. price is about $29,883 while every comparison country is below $17,100
the U.S. price is about 1.75 times the highest comparison country and more than twice the lowest
reject: saying another country has the highest price
describing the values as annual rather than monthly prices
omitting the United States or any comparison country
saying the U.S. price is lower than the other countries
units.evidence: Six country bars share the same vertical dollar scale; the U.S. bar is clearly the tallest.

units.claim: All 6 required bar marks or stacked segments appear in the final chart.
accept: all 6 required data marks are visible
the complete required mark set is present in the final chart
reject: omitting any required bar or stacked segment
replacing missing marks with a summary total or subtitle
units.evidence: G0 data-row coverage is rendered as a complete set of identifiable bar marks.

optional_valid: The narration calls the drug Sevaldi, but the chart title identifies it as Sovaldi.

g0_data_completeness.selection: all data rows (table has no role column)
